bio.text: Karn later found a diagram of the sylex in a sealed Thran workshop, and secretly moved it to Jhoira's workshop on the Mana Rig.
Believing he would die, Karn encased it in titanium and carbon, and Ajani crumpled it, destroying it.
Saheeli built a perfect replica from Karn's plans, and Kaya wrapped the sylex for the strike team's journey.
Teferi saw that Urza had activated it by pouring everything into it, and realized the trigger is a person.
Jace later stood at the Invasion Tree with his hands on the sylex and activated it, pouring his misery into it.
